tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sems bskyed lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyi don du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis/ oṃ swa bhāwa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i don la mngon du phyogs pas/ tha mal gyi lus stong pa nyid las/ skad cig gis ri rab kyi steng du/ zar ma'i me tog kha bye ma thag pa ltar sngo ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can zhal gcig spyan gsum cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ ral pa nag po'i thor tshugs brdzis pa'i steng du/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje 'chang ba/

de'i 'og phyogs kyi g.yon du zla tshes kyi ri mo dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la thub pa mi bskyod pas mdzes pa/ dpral ba'i ngos la thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa shin tu 'dzum pa brgya'i phyed kyi do shal can/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dag gis rdo rje dang chu skyes kyi snod 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis ma/ thod pa skam po lnga'i cod pan dang lnga cu'i do shal dang*/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing grol zhing 'khyil ba/ zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ phyogs kyi gos can/ nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od ltar dmar ba'i rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ dga' ba'i ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi'i ro 'thung ba/ thugs ka'i chu skyes la nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po dang ldan pa/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa/ dwangs shing gsal la rnyog pa med pa/ blta bas chog mi shes pa'i sku me long dri ma med pa la shar ba'i gzugs brnyan lta bu yun ring du bsgom/ de la skyo bar gyur na sa bon la bskor ba'i sngags/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bya ba mang du bzla'o// de'i tshe yid kyis sa bon sngags 'phreng gi 'od zer las bde mchog dpag tu med pa spros pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar yang rang la bsdus shing bsgom mo// gzhan du bshad pa bzhin gyi do li'i bzlas pa yang 'gal ba med par bsam mo// de nas snod kyi 'jig rten bcud kyi sems can la/ de bcom ldan 'das ma la/ de ri rab dang bcas pa'i bdag nyid la/ de yas zhu mas zhu snying ga'i hūm̐ la/ zhabs kyu ha/ ha mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de mi dmigs pa 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag de las langs nas/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi khar/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ hūm̐ oṃ khaṃ aṃ trāṃ dang*/ baṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rlung gis bskyod/ me sbar/ bskol bas sa bon dang bcas pa'i rdzas rnams bzhu/ de'i khar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gyur pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa de dag kyang 'od du zhu/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa la dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje dkar po rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍāki nī sa ma yas+t+waṃ dṛ ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes pas 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la 'bul la/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa bcom// khyod kyi dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi dpyid kyis brlan par gyur ba'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tson+mā da a pasmā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā dā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ khā da tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi ghā tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ dur khrod pa rnams la'o// de nas yig brgya'i sngags kyis lhag chad bskang*/

mgron rnams badz+ra muḥgashegs par bya'o// dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar byed/ ces pa 'di yang mi'i dbang po g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan 'dzin pas bskul ba'i ngor/ pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ//
